name: squad
description: User-invoked /squad, /squad-review, and /scenarios: the main agent mediates planning, runs plan-bound implementation, then a review sequence (deslop, verify, blast-radius, conditional statechart, red tests, reviewers) and at most two fix rounds before an uncommitted hand-off. /squad-review is report-only. /scenarios writes docs/smoke/<slug>.md from changed code.
